title: Bumblebee reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bee body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='58' rx='18' ry='14' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <!-- Stripes -->
  <path d='M30 47 Q33 58 30 69' stroke='#3B2A0A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M42 44 Q45 58 42 72' stroke='#3B2A0A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 47 Q57 58 54 69' stroke='#3B2A0A' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Wings -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#BFE9FF' transform='rotate(-25 30 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#BFE9FF' transform='rotate(15 50 34)'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='46' r='12' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='65' cy='43' r='2.6' fill='#2A1A00'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='43' r='2.6' fill='#2A1A00'/>
  <circle cx='65.9' cy='42.1' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='72.9' cy='42.1' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M64 50 Q68 54 72 50' stroke='#2A1A00' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Antennae -->
  <path d='M64 36 Q60 28 55 26' stroke='#2A1A00' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='26' r='2.2' fill='#2A1A00'/>
  <path d='M72 35 Q74 27 79 24' stroke='#2A1A00' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='24' r='2.2' fill='#2A1A00'/>
  <!-- Book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 45 78)'>
    <rect x='24' y='70' width='44' height='20' rx='2' fill='#E85D5D'/>
    <rect x='24' y='70' width='22' height='20' rx='2' fill='#F27E7E'/>
    <line x1='46' y1='70' x2='46' y2='90' stroke='#B33A3A' stroke-width='2'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='76' x2='42' y2='76' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='80' x2='42' y2='80' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='30' y1='84' x2='39' y2='84' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='76' x2='62' y2='76' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='80' x2='62' y2='80' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='84' x2='59' y2='84' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Arms holding book -->
  <path d='M52 62 Q48 68 46 72' stroke='#C79A00' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 64 Q60 70 60 72' stroke='#C79A00' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Stinger -->
  <path d='M24 58 L18 58' stroke='#2A1A00' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
